errors.text: The proposed temperature-dependent rate sensitivity contradicts the target result: yield strength was insensitive to strain rate throughout 10^8–10^10 s^-1 at 10, 300, and 600 K, rather than only above 0.5 Tm.
The central cross-slip-locking argument is extrapolated from a BCC MoNbTaW refractory HEA and is not valid evidence for yielding in FCC FeNiCrMn.
The hypothesis predicts cryogenic nano-twinning, whereas the target mechanism is Shockley-partial glide with intrinsic and extrinsic stacking faults and explicitly no twinning.

It replaces the simulated single-crystal, crystallographic-orientation-dependent MD loading regime with conventional experimental strain rates and does not recover the strong orientation anisotropy or maximum yield stress along <-111>.
The claimed high Peierls barrier and associated suppression of cross-slip in the FCC alloy are unsupported by the cited evidence.
The response does not address any relationship between mechanical behavior and corrosion resistance.
